questions.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees accrue per month?
expected_answer_points: 1.75 days per completed month, max 21 days/year

questions.question: What is the maximum annual leave carry-forward into the next year?
expected_answer_points: 5 days standard, up to 10 with manager+HR exception for client-critical projects

questions.question: How many days of paid parental leave does a secondary caregiver get?
expected_answer_points: 14 calendar days

questions.question: What is the per-diem for international business travel?
expected_answer_points: USD 60/day international, USD 35/day domestic

questions.question: Within how many days must an expense report be submitted after a trip?
expected_answer_points: 14 calendar days, hard cutoff 30 days without exception approval

questions.question: How many remote days per week are allowed under the standard hybrid arrangement?
expected_answer_points: up to 2 remote days per week

questions.question: How many days per year can an employee work remotely from another country?
expected_answer_points: capped at 20 working days/year unless separate agreement or international assignment

questions.question: How often must passwords be changed under the information security policy?
expected_answer_points: every 180 days, min 12 characters, no reuse of last 5

questions.question: Within what timeframe must a suspected security incident be reported?
expected_answer_points: within 1 hour of discovery

questions.question: What is the standard probation period length for new hires?
expected_answer_points: 90 days from date of joining, extendable by up to 30 days

questions.question: If I'm a new hire working remotely and want to claim travel per-diem for a work trip in my first month, what rules apply?
expected_answer_points: onboarding timeline/requirements apply regardless of travel; per-diem rules from travel policy apply the same way to any employee

questions.question: Can a fully remote employee working from another country store confidential client data on a personal laptop?
questions.expected_section: Remote Work Section 5; Info Security Section 3.2
expected_answer_points: no - security policy prohibits restricted/confidential data on personal devices regardless of remote work arrangement

questions.question: During onboarding, what security training is required and by when, and what device security rules apply to the laptop issued on Day One?
expected_answer_points: security awareness training within 7 working days; issued laptop must meet Section 4.1 device security requirements

questions.question: Can an employee book business class for a 5-hour flight and expense alcohol at a client dinner?
expected_answer_points: business class generally not allowed under 6 hours unless medical exception; alcohol not reimbursable unless part of client meal per Section 7
